reason: An MCP-based integration that lets an agent inspect and edit open Synthesizer V Studio Pro projects through the official scripting API, with tuning tools, status controls, a panel, and bridge-script installation.

summaries.zh: 通过官方脚本 API 和 MCP 将智能体连接到 Synthesizer V Studio Pro，用于检查工程并编辑音符、歌词、调音曲线及相关参数。
summaries.en: Connects an agent to Synthesizer V Studio Pro through its official scripting API and MCP tools to inspect projects and edit notes, lyrics, tuning curves, and related parameters.

capabilities: Connects to Synthesizer V Studio Pro through its official scripting API
Reads and edits open Synthesizer V projects, including notes, lyrics, automation curves, tuning attributes, selections, and playback state
Installs or removes bridge Lua scripts in Synthesizer V script directories
Uses local temporary-directory file IPC between the MCP runtime and Synthesizer V
